system_a.summary: Across the reviews, the most consistent strength is location: guests describe a short drive or inexpensive rideshare to downtown Asheville, with some restaurants within walking distance. Recent reviews (2024–2026) also mention a comfortable bed, a full kitchen, easy check-in, private entrance and parking, a coffee bar, an honor-system snack and beer bar, and a sauna. Hosts are described as responsive and friendly. Several guests found the space clean and quiet, and many saw it as good for short stays. Limitations: the basement unit is described as modest or dated, with little natural light. Recent reviewers report hearing footsteps from upstairs, though some found it manageable with a noise machine or headphones. Older concerns include a 2016 report of serious cleanliness problems and bugs, a note about connected upstairs access, a shared laundry room, and no TV. Recent reviews do not repeat those cleanliness concerns; they describe the space as clean.

system_b.summary: Reviews from 2016 through 2026 consistently praise the location: guests describe a short, inexpensive rideshare or roughly 10-minute drive to downtown Asheville, with restaurants nearby. One 2016 guest found it about a mile out and not bike-friendly. Beds, linens, the kitchen, coffee bar, private parking, easy self check-in and responsive hosts are widely appreciated, and a sauna is mentioned from 2023 on. Noise is mixed: many guests found the basement unit quiet, but footsteps from upstairs were reported in 2018, 2025 (mild with a noise machine) and 2026 (7am-9pm), so this may recur. Privacy concerns, an internal door (2016) and an unlocked shared laundry room (2018), came from a minority, while others praised the private entrance and felt safe; no recent review resolves these concerns. Cleanliness is praised, including as spotless in 2026, but 2016 reports described mildew and bugs. Other minority remarks cite thin natural light, dated furnishings, no TV (current status unclear) and some value complaints. Similarly worded recent reviews may not be independent.

selected_claims.claim: Guests overwhelmingly praise the location: close to downtown Asheville (short, cheap rideshare or about a 10-minute drive), with restaurants walkable from the unit. One 2016 reviewer described it as about a mile from downtown, not bike-friendly, with peak Uber fares around $20 each way.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Praised consistently from 2016 through 2026; the one dissent is from 2016
selected_claims.uncertainty: Walkability to downtown itself is described inconsistently; some reviews cover only nearby food. Some recent location reviews are generic and similarly worded, so they are not necessarily independent.

selected_claims.claim: Upstairs footsteps are a recurring noise concern in this basement unit. One 2018 guest heard footsteps until past midnight through thin floors. A 2026 guest reported footsteps from 7am-9pm. A 2025 guest found it mild with a noise machine over two nights. Many other guests describe the unit as quiet or heard nothing from upstairs.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Footstep complaints appear in 2018, 2025 and 2026, so the issue is present in recent reviews; quiet reports span 2016-2026
selected_claims.uncertainty: Experience likely depends on upstairs occupancy and guest sensitivity; the ledger cannot confirm how often it occurs.

selected_claims.claim: Privacy and security concerns are reported by a minority. A 2016 guest described an internal door linking the unit to the upstairs house as unsafe and feared people entering when they came home late. A 2018 guest said the shared laundry room, which an upstairs tenant can access, was unlocked on arrival and that the unit was less private than described. Many other guests praise the private entrance, separate driveway and privacy, and some say they felt safe, including a solo female traveler in 2023.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Concerns date from 2016 and 2018; reassurances run through 2023, and privacy praise continues into 2026
selected_claims.uncertainty: The layout may have changed since 2016 and 2018; no recent review confirms or resolves the door or laundry access concerns.

selected_claims.claim: Cleanliness is praised by most reviewers, including recent ones ("spotless" in 2026). One 2016 review reported filthy conditions, mildew, and bugs, and another from 2016 reported a mildew smell on the couch and a musty bed.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Negative reports are from 2016; no later cleanliness complaints appear in the ledger
selected_claims.uncertainty: Cannot say whether the 2016 issues were resolved. The absence of later complaints is not proof.

selected_claims.claim: Beds and linens are widely described as very comfortable, and the apartment as cozy and spacious. Some reviewers mention thin comfort trade-offs: worn or outdated furnishings, a small bathroom, very little natural light (walkout basement), and no guest control of heating or cooling in 2016.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Bed praise spans 2018-2025; the negatives are mostly 2016-2019
selected_claims.uncertainty: Later renovations are hinted at (2023, 2024) but not verified in detail.

selected_claims.claim: Amenities are widely appreciated: full kitchen, free coffee bar, honor-system snacks and local beer, toiletries, strong water pressure, private parking, and in recent years a sauna. A few guests noted the absence of a TV or cable, and one said the listing specifies no TV.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Sauna mentions begin in 2023 and continue to 2026; the no-TV remarks are from 2016-2019, and a Roku TV is mentioned in 2022
selected_claims.uncertainty: The current TV status is unclear.

selected_claims.claim: Check-in is consistently described as easy, with self check-in, clear instructions, and a flat driveway beside the entrance. selected_claims.uncertainty: Only one reviewer reported poor communication.

selected_claims.uncertainty: Prices vary over time, and current rates are not in the ledger.
